meta.name: dial-cli
meta.description: Reference for the `dial` CLI — gives you a real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts/codes via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Use when the user mentions phones, calls, texts, SMS, voice, OTP, 2FA, or verification codes; when they ask to text, call, ring, or wait for a code from someone; before running any `dial …` command for the first time in a session; or when investigating what the Dial platform can do. Load this skill before invoking the CLI — `dial --help` alone will not surface the workflows, the `--json` conventions, or the docs-lookup pattern needed to use Dial correctly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行发送短信、拨打电话并接收验证码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在命令行中完成短信和通话
copy.tagline_en: Send SMS, make voice calls, and receive codes from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a real phone number for texts and calls via CLI

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以用 dial CLI 操作一个真实电话号码:发短信、发起由 AI 语音代理接听的通话、等待并读取收到的短信或验证码。它返回命令输出、消息和通话结果。
howto.when: 当你提到电话、短信、SMS、语音、OTP、2FA、验证码等关键词,或要求给某人发短信、打电话、等验证码时触发;会话中首次运行 dial 命令前也应加载本技能。

say.text: 用 dial message 给 +14155550123 发条短信:'你好'
用 dial call 给 +14155550123 打个电话,说我们明天见
say.note: 通话结束后用 call get 查看

say.text: 用 dial wait-for 等一条短信验证码
say.note: 收到后从正文解析验证码

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can use the Dial CLI to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts or verification codes on a real phone number. It returns command output plus message and call results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention phones, calls, texts, SMS, voice, OTP, 2FA, or verification codes, ask to text or call someone, wait for a code, or before the first dial command in a session.

say_en.text: Send an SMS with dial message to +14155550123 saying 'hello'
Place a dial call to +14155550123 telling them we'll meet tomorrow
say_en.note: Check it after with dial call get <id>

say_en.text: Use dial wait-for to wait for an SMS verification code
say_en.note: Parses the code from the body
